entities.name: Query protein 503 aa
observations: Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt protein A0A125QZE2 from Salvia miltiorrhiza.
Annotated as 11-hydroxysugiol 20-monooxygenase, a heme-dependent cytochrome P450 monooxygenase.
Sequence length is 503 aa; calculated molecular mass is 56.23 kDa and theoretical pI is 8.97.
Contains one N-terminal hydrophobic transmembrane helix approximately residues 2–22 and a Pfam P450 domain spanning residues 35–491.
Reference feature identifies the conserved heme axial-binding residue near position 446.
Predicted membrane-associated single-pass protein; exact topology and orientation are annotation-derived rather than independently predicted here.

entities.name: A0A125QZE2
observations: Reviewed UniProt entry from Salvia miltiorrhiza; exact sequence match to the query.
Catalyzes oxidation of 11-hydroxysugiol to 11,20-dihydroxysugiol and can oxidize 11-hydroxyferruginol to 11,20-dihydroxyferruginol.
EC 1.14.14.67; heme cofactor; functions in terpenoid and tanshinone-related secondary metabolism.
Annotated as a single-pass membrane protein with heme and iron-ion binding activities.

entities.name: Heme
observations: Annotated cofactor for the query-matched cytochrome P450 monooxygenase; ChEBI:CHEBI:30413.

entities.name: 11-hydroxysugiol oxidation
observations: 11-hydroxysugiol is oxidized to 11,20-dihydroxysugiol using O2 and reducing equivalents supplied by a NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase system; Rhea RHEA:55464.

entities.name: Terpenoid secondary metabolism
observations: The matched enzyme is annotated in terpenoid biosynthesis, including tanshinone-related diterpenoid metabolism.
